source_documents.title: From dark TICT state to Emissive quasi-TICT State: The AIE Mechanism of N-(3-(benzo[d]oxazol-2-yl)phenyl)-4-tert-butylbenzamide

reference_evidence_units.quote: The fluorescence quantum yield of 3OTB powder is 8±2%, 47- times higher than that of THF solution (0.17%)
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3OTB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: THF solution versus powder; integrating sphere for solids, reported error +/-2%.
reference_evidence_units.statement: 3OTB is weak in THF (0.17%) and enhanced in powder (8+/-2%).
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Later text reports powder 9% and crystal 8%; do not impose the abstract's strict crystal-greater-than-powder ordering.

reference_evidence_units.quote: with increase of solvent polarity, the TICT emission red shifts together with a decrease of the relative intensity
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3OTB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Aprotic solvents at 1e-5 M; excitation 290 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Long-wavelength band shifts with polarity and weakens, unlike the near-UV LE band.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: TICT is the authors' assignment; protic solvents suppress this band and hydrogen bonding is only suggested.

reference_evidence_units.quote: when the water content is larger than 90%, the molecules begin to aggregate
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3OTB
reference_evidence_units.statement: Main text links new approximately 450 nm emission to scattering tails and TEM-observed aggregation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Boundary wording is approximate: 10:90 THF/water nanosheets are discussed elsewhere; no sharp universal threshold inferred.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Due to these weak interactions, the free configuration twist is partially restricted and a quasi-TICT* state can be formed
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3OTB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Single crystals grown from ethyl acetate; weak contacts listed in Figure 6.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors connect crystal contacts to partial twisting restriction and quasi-TICT emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Not a measured excited-state crystal geometry; SI calculations were not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: while the electron transition in 1x* (λcal = 479 nm, f= 0.003)
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3OTB
reference_evidence_units.statement: The relaxed TICT minimum has calculated 479 nm emission and f=0.003, compared with LE f=0.877 and 315 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The computed minima and oscillator strengths are model results; the source is not fully consistent about CT direction, so no direction is adjudicated.

reference_evidence_units.quote: calculated absorption spectra and maximum wavelengths of the selected dimer from crystal structures show almost no spectral shift when compared with monomer
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3OTB dimer and monomer
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Main-text report of SI Figure S4.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The selected dimer is reported to have little absorption shift from monomer.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI not inspected; no affirmative excimer or exciton mechanism follows from aggregation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The intramolecular relaxation along the 1x* PES will be stopped at an intermediate point
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3OTB
reference_evidence_units.statement: Partial restriction stops relaxation before the dark TICT minimum, creating an emissive quasi-TICT state.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A proposed intermediate configuration, not independently time-resolved structural proof; PES crossing is not automatically a conical intersection.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The emission in powder and crystal is peaked at 440 nm while that in nanoaggregates and films at 446 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3OTB morphologies
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Powder, crystal, nanoaggregate and spin-coated film.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Powder/crystal peaks are 440 nm; nanoaggregates/films 446 nm. Text reports yields 9%, 8%, and 2% for powder, crystal, and film.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Source's yield ordering conflicts with abstract; differences of powder and crystal are within stated approximately 2% uncertainty.

reference_evidence_units.quote: replaced by the structured phosphorescence (with detecting lifetime longer than µs magnitude, see Figure S6).
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3OTB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 105-77 K cooling in meTHF; main-text report referring to SI Figure S6.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign the lowest-temperature structured emission to phosphorescence with longer-than-microsecond lifetime.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Low-temperature triplet assignment only, not room-temperature aggregate phosphorescence; SI trace not inspected.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Partial restriction of twisting enables quasi-TICT emission; same pathway as the primary label.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Intermolecular contacts and morphology order are invoked to set the extent of rotational restriction.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Emissive quasi-TICT produced by incomplete relaxation toward dark TICT is the central source interpretation.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Explicit oscillator-strength changes along relaxation distinguish bright LE/quasi-TICT from dark relaxed TICT.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Preserve the explicit low-temperature phosphorescence assignment only; it is not the AIE mechanism at ambient conditions.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Partial restriction of twisting enables quasi-TICT emission; same pathway as the primary label.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Intermolecular contacts and morphology order are invoked to set the extent of rotational restriction.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No guest-binding or inclusion mechanism linked to target emission established; solvent polarity alone does not establish host-guest binding.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Emissive quasi-TICT produced by incomplete relaxation toward dark TICT is the central source interpretation.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer mechanism established; hydrogen bonding or ground-state acid-base chemistry alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No separate photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on established; intramolecular CT is not automatically PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Aggregation alone does not establish excitonic coupling, H/J aggregation, excimer or exciplex emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Explicit oscillator-strength changes along relaxation distinguish bright LE/quasi-TICT from dark relaxed TICT.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Preserve the explicit low-temperature phosphorescence assignment only; it is not the AIE mechanism at ambient conditions.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection-mediated nonradiative pathway established; twisting alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No emission from higher excited states or suppression of Kasha's rule established.
